title: Agentic Autoresearch for Cell-Edge Power Control: Radically Redefining the Researcher's Role
abstract: arXiv:2608.26093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing machine learning algorithms for wireless resource management is labour-intensive: the architecture, the loss function and the training recipe are all specified by hand. We demonstrate that this design layer can be surrendered to an autonomous agent in its entirety. We adopt the autoresearch protocol, in which an AI coding agent edits a training script, runs a fixed-budget experiment, and retains or discards the change according to a single immutable metric. We grant the agent authority over the architecture family, the input representation, the output parameterization, the loss function and the task-sampling law, and set it a target chosen for its difficulty: sum-least-percentile-rate power control across a multicell network. The formulation targets cell-edge throughput and is non-convex, non-smooth and strongly NP-hard away from its max-min vertex. translated_title: 智能体自主研究用于小区边缘功率控制：彻底重新定义研究者的角色
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.26093v1 公告类型：新 摘要：为无线资源管理设计机器学习算法是劳动密集型的：架构、损失函数和训练方案都需要手工指定。我们证明这一设计层可以完全交给一个自主智能体。我们采用自主研究协议，其中AI编码智能体编辑训练脚本，运行固定预算实验，并根据单个不可变指标保留或丢弃更改。我们授予智能体对架构族、输入表示、输出参数化、损失函数和任务采样规则的权力，并为其设定一个因难度而选定的目标：跨多小区网络的总最小百分位速率功率控制。该公式针对小区边缘吞吐量，且是非凸、非光滑，并且在其最大最小顶点之外是强NP难的。保障措施使结果可信：哈希固定的评估器、强制的...
tldr: 本文提出一种完全自主的智能体研究框架，将无线资源管理算法设计（包括架构、损失函数等）全部交给AI编码智能体，在固定预算下通过自动编辑和评估实现小区边缘功率控制的优化，从而彻底改变研究者的角色。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fully autonomous agentic research framework that delegates all algorithm design (architecture, loss function, etc.) for wireless resource management to an AI coding agent, optimizing cell-edge power control via automated editing and evaluation under a fixed budget, radically redefining the researcher's role.
